entities.name: REST/NRSF
observations: Lithium reduced REST/NRSF protein abundance and DNA-binding activity in rat embryonic neural stem cells exposed to ethanol; neuronal differentiation increased.

NRSF/REST was inferred as an upstream regulatory mechanism from a lithium/valproate-regulated gene set in human SH-SY5Y cells, without direct measurement of REST expression, occupancy, binding, or activity.

entities.name: Lithium
observations: In rat embryonic neural stem cells, lithium increased neuronal differentiation and reduced ethanol-induced REST/NRSF protein abundance and DNA-binding activity.
Lithium regulated a nine-gene mood-disorder-associated signature in SH-SY5Y cells whose transcriptional-network enrichment implicated NRSF/REST.

entities.name: Valproate
observations: Valproate shared an indirect NRSF/REST transcriptional-network enrichment signal with lithium in SH-SY5Y cells.
A broader lithium/valproate study identified 936 significant expression changes and validated Six1 induction, but did not establish REST as the driver.

entities.name: Carbamazepine
observations: Carbamazepine participated in a shared astrocytic FEZ1 induction signature with lithium, valproate, and lamotrigine, but no direct REST/NRSF assay or REST-target gene-set analysis was identified.

entities.name: Lamotrigine
observations: Lamotrigine altered 14 genes in primary rat hippocampal cells and increased GABA-A receptor beta3 expression, but no direct REST/NRSF measurement or REST-target enrichment was identified.
Lamotrigine participated in a shared astrocytic FEZ1 induction signature with three other mood stabilisers.

entities.name: FEZ1
observations: FEZ1 was the only gene commonly induced by lithium, valproic acid, carbamazepine, and lamotrigine in human astrocyte-derived cells; induction was validated at RNA and protein levels.
The shared FEZ1 response was not shown to be REST/NRSF-mediated.

entities.name: SIX1
observations: Six1 showed up to 31.3-fold induction in a broad lithium/valproate SH-SY5Y microarray study and was mechanistically linked to anti-apoptotic protection; REST/NRSF was not established as its mediator.

entities.name: PMID:18671961
observations: Lithium-induced suppression of transcription repressor NRSF/REST was reported in rat embryonic neural stem cells under ethanol-induced differentiation impairment.

entities.name: PMID:25451397
observations: Mood-stabiliser-regulated genes in human SH-SY5Y cells showed transcriptional-network enrichment implicating NRSF/REST; this was an indirect inference.
